proposals: The Department of Pharmaceuticals should publish applications and approvals under the SMDI components window by product line, including X-ray tubes, ultrasound probes and pacemaker components, so that gaps left by single-applicant or zero-applicant lines under PLI-MD can be seen closing, or not, after June 2026.

The Department of Pharmaceuticals should publish an annual table mapping every device made under PLI-MD to the HS lines it substitutes, with imports and exports for each, so that results like the 8.5% fall in MRI imports and the +165% rise in X-ray tube imports appear in official reporting.

The Department of Pharmaceuticals should publish a gap assessment for lab and analytical instruments (HS 9027) and IVD reagents (HS 3822) before any PLI 2.0 is designed, since these are the two largest deficit families, at $2.19bn and about $1.1bn, and had no PLI presence.

The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare should publish the domestic-manufacture share of oxygen concentrators bought through central and state public procurement, so that whether imports up 30% despite four PLI applicants is a procurement problem, as this piece suggests, can be tested.
